live_state_before_mitigation.watchdog_entrypoint: python3 ops/automation_control.py ensure-normal ... && exec python3 ops/watchdog.py --loop
live_state_before_mitigation.sentinel_entrypoint: python3 ops/automation_control.py ensure-normal ... && while true; do python3 ops/stack_sentinel.py; sleep ...; done

source_fix_intent.watchdog: Detect ASIC API-stall/missing-lane failures from current pool metrics without legacy job_notify_count, and allow one-at-a-time ASIC open restart even when only one ASIC lane remains healthy.
source_fix_intent.status_sampler: Compose deployments can keep watchdog/sentinel guard containers alive with BDAG_MINING_IMPERATIVE_GUARD_CONTAINERS=watchdog,sentinel.
source_fix_intent.stack_status_source: Accept Redis live dashboard status as repair-grade only when source=redis-live, overall is present, and miner_health exists; this preserves per-ASIC rows for watchdog repairs.
source_fix_intent.dashboard: Report Mining Degraded when expected configured ASIC fleet is not ready, instead of showing full Mining OK for one productive lane.

allowed_live_mitigation_from_this_savepo: Allow watchdog to attempt one ASIC open restart at a time for confirmed stalled ASIC lanes.
Do not restart node or pool for this ASIC-controller failure.
Do not rewrite ASIC pool configuration unless MCB /mcb/pools later becomes readable and proves it is wrong.
rollback_commands: docker start watchdog sentinel can be undone by docker stop watchdog sentinel
No node/pool/dashboard/image rollback is required for the planned guard-container start because node, pool, dashboard, and status-sampler are not changed by that action.
If source changes need to be reverted before commit, use git diff to inspect and git restore only the files listed in source_refs.dirty_summary after confirming with the user.
hard_safety_rules: Do not start live node with p2p module.
Do not restart node or pool to repair ASIC MCB/API reset stalls.
Protect the productive 192.168.1.106 / 28:e2:97:4d:44:3a lane while repairing failed lanes one at a time.
A dashboard status of Mining OK is not sufficient when expected ASIC ready count is below configured count.
